data.one_liner: Retrieve App Group directory on iOS.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin to access shared application group container on iOS. It acts as a port of FileManager.containerURL to Flutter.
use_when: You need to share data between your main iOS app and an iOS extension using App Groups.
You need to retrieve the shared app group container directory URL.
avoid_when: You are developing strictly for Android without iOS support.
You do not use App Groups on iOS.
strengths: Simple API to access shared app group containers on iOS.
weaknesses: Limited to iOS platform app group directories based on the documentation.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up App Groups in Xcode for iOS.
